column3: Information Disclosure - Debug Error Messages (app-level: stack traces must never reach users)
Cookie No HttpOnly Flag (app sets cookies itself)
Cookie Without Secure Flag (app sets cookies itself)
Cookie without SameSite Attribute (app sets cookies itself)
X-Content-Type-Options Header Missing (often set at ingress; verify on the prod-parity stand)
Content Security Policy (CSP) Header Not Set (often set at ingress; verify on the prod-parity stand)
Missing Anti-clickjacking Header (often set at ingress; JSON API, low impact)
Strict-Transport-Security Header Not Set (TLS terminates at ingress; no TLS inside CI)
Server Leaks Version Information via Server header (dev server in CI; prod runs behind a proxy)
Non-Storable Content / caching informational (noise for an API)
